name: PTR character copy: .ptr copy duplicates the player's own character once
contract: A player copies their own character from the source realm's characters schema with .ptr copy <name> (src/server/coa/CoAPtrCharacterCopy.cpp, PlayerDump). The copy is a new character on the same account that carries the inventory; a name already taken here is renamed at login. A character keeps at most one live copy, and a player cannot copy a character of another account or an unknown name. ptr_character_copy uses this realm's own schema as the source.

steps.label: The source account starts with one character
DISCRIMINATING: the copy is a second character on the same account
DISCRIMINATING: the copy carries the inventory
The taken name is renamed at login
steps.text: choose a new one at login

steps.label: A second copy of the same character is refused
The refused copy adds no character
Another account cannot copy the character
The other account gains no character
The unknown name adds no character
